newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish prosecutors investigate Islamist charity.
newsitem.headline: Turkish prosecutors investigate Islamist charity.

text.p: Turkish prosecutors have opened an investigation into a charitable foundation with close links to the Islam-based Welfare Party of former prime minister Necmettin Erbakan, a prosecutor said on Monday.

"We opened the investigation after searching the premises of the National Youth Foundation (MGV)...The reason for this is that the MGV had become a focus of activities against the secular nature of the state," Ankara prosecutor Nuh Mete Yuksel told Reuters.

Yuksel said that during the searches of MGV premises last week, prosecutors found evidence implicating the foundation in political activities. Under Turkish law, charitable foundations must be non-political.
Police seized documents, cassettes and video tapes at the foundation offices.
The investigation is the first step which could lead to prosecution and closure of the MGV -- commonly regarded as the youth wing of Welfare.
Erbakan, Turkey's first Islamist prime minister, was forced to resign in June after months of pressure by the secularist establishment led by the powerful military.
His party faces a separate threat of closure on charges it sought to undermine Turkey's official secular order.
